title: 核心通胀关键指标：一年无进展，美联储加息选项重回桌面
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I mean, when we look at inflation, which is really what's driving fed policy, all the fundamentals to us point toward up-sagrissed to inflation. You have above-trend GDP growth.
segments.zh: 通胀是驱动美联储政策的关键，所有基本面都指向通胀上行风险，GDP增长高于趋势。

segments.en: We have a labor market. We think it's heating up. We have a range of supply-side challenges, energy, but also in trade, labor, all these things where you think are going to keep inflation
segments.zh: 劳动力市场在升温，供给侧挑战包括能源、贸易和劳动力，这些都会让通胀保持高位。

segments.en: elevated and the fed hawker. I put it, Orzag, and Pozen. I think it was out in January.
segments.zh: 美联储鹰派声音增强，Orzag和Pozen在1月就指出了这一点。

segments.en: It may be when I noted the year, but they are with you looking for sustained lift.
segments.zh: 他们也在寻找持续的上行动力。

segments.en: Is it because of labor market pulling in to the Orzag Pozen wage growth that gets us there?
segments.zh: 是因为劳动力市场推动Orzag-Pozen工资增长吗？

segments.en: That is part of it. One of the most concerning parts of inflation are what we're seeing in non-shelter services. That's the majority of core PCE, which is what the fed's looking at.
segments.zh: 部分原因。最令人担忧的是非住房服务通胀，它占核心PCE的大部分，美联储正关注这一点。

segments.en: And that's running at high levels shown no progress over the last year.
segments.zh: 该指标处于高位，过去一年未见进展。

segments.en: And we think the labor market is tightening. Weage growth is going to feel upside-pressure.
segments.zh: 劳动力市场趋紧，工资增长面临上行压力。

segments.en: That can put more pressure on those sticky inflation numbers. That's why I think some fed officials are starting to talk about. With the backdrop that we have now,
segments.zh: 这会给粘性通胀数据带来更多压力，因此一些美联储官员开始讨论当前背景。

segments.en: we can't be confident we're going to trend back to a 2.0% inflation rate. More like the mid-toes may be your high-toes, but we need some rate hikes here to bring inflation back to target.
segments.zh: 我们无法确信通胀会回到2%，可能在中高区间，需要加息才能实现目标。

segments.en: So last week, soft CPI and to less extent PPI data was that more a function of energy prices coming down during the initial days of this memorandum of understanding kind of thing?
segments.zh: 上周，核心CPI和PPI数据走软，更多是能源价格在初期下跌的结果吗？
